answer: You can starve a sybil farm by front-loading its costs. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the mesa of free entry disappears, the beacon of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the timber case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops being rational.
